# cmtools

The goal of cmtools is to …

## Installation

You can install the development version of cmtools from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("edsandorf/cmtools")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(cmtools)
## basic example code
```

What is special about using `README.Rmd` instead of just `README.md`?
You can include R chunks like so:

``` r

summary(cars)
#>      speed           dist       
#>  Min.   : 4.0   Min.   :  2.00  
#>  1st Qu.:12.0   1st Qu.: 26.00  
#>  Median :15.0   Median : 36.00  
#>  Mean   :15.4   Mean   : 42.98  
#>  3rd Qu.:19.0   3rd Qu.: 56.00  
#>  Max.   :25.0   Max.   :120.00
```

You’ll still need to render `README.Rmd` regularly, to keep `README.md`
up-to-date. `devtools::build_readme()` is handy for this.

You can also embed plots, for example:

![](reference/figures/README-pressure-1.png)

In that case, don’t forget to commit and push the resulting figure
files, so they display on GitHub and CRAN.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`AIC(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/AIC.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  AIC of a `bgw_mle` object

- [`BIC(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/BIC.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  BIC of a `bgw_mle` object

- [`add_scores()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/add_scores.md)
  : Calculates and adds the scores to a fitted model object

- [`bread()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/bread.md) : Bread
  for sandwiches

- [`coef(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/coef.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  Coefficients of a `bgw_mle` object

- [`converged()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/converged.md)
  : Check if model has converged

- [`.onAttach()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/dot-onAttach.md)
  : Print package startup message

- [`glance(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/glance.bgw_mle.md)
  : Glance a \`bgw_mle´ object

- [`has_scores()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/has_scores.md)
  : Check if the model object contains the scores

- [`is_bgw()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/is_bgw.md) :

  Check if the model object is of class `bwg_mle`

- [`load_packages()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/load_packages.md)
  : Load packages

- [`logLik(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/logLik.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  Log-likelihood of a `bgw_mle` object

- [`meat()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/meat.md) : Meat
  for sandwiches

- [`nobs(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/nobs.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  Number of observations of a `bgw_mle` object

- [`poe_test()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/poe_test.md) :
  Test for the difference in independent empirical distributions

- [`prep_for_gt()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/prep_for_gt.md)
  :

  Prepare model output for `gt`

- [`print(`*`<poe_test>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/print.poe_test.md)
  :

  Generic print method for
  [`poe_test()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/poe_test.md)

- [`repeat_rows()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/repeat_rows.md)
  : Repeat rows

- [`sandwich()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/sandwich.md) :
  Sandwich estimator

- [`scores()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/scores.md) :
  Extract the empirical estimation function

- [`search_starting_values()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/search_starting_values.md)
  : Function to search for starting values

- [`stars()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/stars.md) :
  Create stars

- [`suggest_parallel()`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/suggest_parallel.md)
  : Function to suggest parallel settings

- [`tidy(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/tidy.bgw_mle.md)
  : Tidy a \`bgw_mle´ object

- [`vcov(`*`<bgw_mle>`*`)`](http://modeltools.edsandorf.me/reference/vcov.bgw_mle.md)
  :

  Variance-covariance matrix of a `bgw_mle` object
